mapper.select: SELECT t.warning_order_id, t.warning_source, t.task_id, t.warning_type_id, t.alarm_time, t.tenant_id, t.tenant_name, t.longitude, t.latitude, t.alarm_body, t.remark, t.delete_remark AS "deleteRemark", t.description, t.address, t.process_id, t.process_name, t.group_id, t.creator, t.emergency_level, t.order_status, t.flow_node_time, t.find_name, t.find_mobile, t.file_img_url_src, t.file_img_url_icon, t.video_url, t.create_time, t.modifier_date, t.time_limit, t.algorithm_code, t.grid_name, t.judge_time, t.org_record, t.user_record, t.duplicate_order_id, t.province_code AS "provinceId", t.province_name, t.city_code AS "cityId", t.city_name, t.county_code AS "countyCode", t.county_name, t.town_code, t.town_Name AS "townName", t.grid_id, t.grid_code, t.device_name, t.channel_name, t.device_code, t.channel_code, t.ptz_p AS "pan", t.ptz_t AS "tilt", t.ptz_z AS "zoom", t.alarm_code, t.voice, t.judge_result, t.real_link_type, t.flow_id, t.link_id, t.link_name, t.flow_template, t.role_id, t.app_ver_code, t.alarm_param, t.alarm_param_value, t.extra_field, t.false_alarm_remark, t.hori_azimuth_angle, t.importance_level, t.front_alarm_pic_url, t.front_alarm_vedio_url, t.msg_id, t.msg_type AS "msgType", t.notice_resource, t.confidence_level, t.confidence_level_min, t.comp_confidence_level, t.camera_alarm_type, t.is_second_judge, t.second_judge_result, t.is_second_identify, t.second_identify_result, t.linkage_algorithm, t.transparent_fields AS "transparentFields", t.feature_pan, t.feature_tilt, t.before_dispatch_flag, t.preset_id, t.enlarge_flag, t.confidence_level_max, t.enable_acceptance_mode, t.time_limit_acceptance, t.alarm_reason AS "alarmReason", t.device_pitch AS "devicePitch", t.device_horizontal AS "deviceHorizontal", t.delete_flag, t.industry_code FROM (SELECT * FROM ${lastTableName} WHERE ( modifier_date IS NOT NULL AND modifier_date >= #{startDate} AND modifier_date < #{endDate} ) OR ( modifier_date IS NULL AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE ( modifier_date IS NOT NULL AND modifier_date >= #{startDate} AND modifier_date < #{endDate} ) OR ( modifier_date IS NULL AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} ) ) t ORDER BY t.modifier_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT dataTable.order_flow_id, dataTable.order_id, dataTable.link_id, dataTable.link_name, dataTable.flow_record_name, DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.flow_node_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "flowNodeTime", IF(dataTable.flow_end_time IS NULL,'',DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.flow_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS "flowEndTime", dataTable.if_current_link, dataTable.process_id, dataTable.process_name, dataTable.group_id, dataTable.if_timeout, dataTable.creator, dataTable.delete_flag, dataTable.process_order_id, dataTable.approve_order_id, dataTable.remark, dataTable.close_remark AS "closeRemark", dataTable.time_limit, dataTable.voice, dataTable.process_name_list, dataTable.flow_link_type, dataTable.real_link_type, dataTable.next_link_id, dataTable.next_link_name, dataTable.accept_process_id, dataTable.enable_acceptance_mode FROM ${tableName} AS dataTable WHERE dataTable.delete_flag = '0'
and dataTable.order_id in
#{item}
ORDER BY dataTable.flow_node_time DESC, dataTable.order_flow_id DESC

SELECT a.warning_order_id, a.warning_source, a.tenant_id, a.tenant_name, a.task_id, a.alarm_body, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.channel_code, a.channel_name, a.warning_type_id, a.warning_type_name, a.alarm_time, a.province_id, a.province_name, a.city_id, a.city_name, a.county_id, a.county_name, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.img_url, a.create_time, a.modifier_time, a.delete_flag, a.ptz_p, a.ptz_t, a.ptz_z, a.address, a.alarm_code, a.algorithm_code, a.emergency_level, a.emergency_level_name, a.duplicate_order_id, a.false_alarm_remark, a.create_user, a.create_user_name, a.judge_result, IF(a.judge_time IS NULL,'',DATE_FORMAT(a.judge_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS "judgeTime", a.grid_id, a.grid_name, a.video_url, a.file_img_url_icon, a.importance_level, a.alarm_param, a.alarm_param_value, a.extra_field, a.operate_type, a.industry_code, a.app_ver_code, a.alarm_param, a.alarm_param_value, a.extra_field, a.msg_type, a.notice_resource, a.confidence_level, a.confidence_level_min, a.comp_confidence_level, a.front_alarm_pic_url, a.front_alarm_vedio_url, a.hori_azimuth_angle, a.msg_id, a.camera_alarm_type, a.is_second_judge, a.second_judge_result, a.is_second_identify, a.second_identify_result, a.linkage_algorithm, a.town_code, a.town_name, a.preset_id, a.enlarge_flag, a.confidence_level_max, a.device_pitch AS "devicePitch", a.device_horizontal AS "deviceHorizontal", a.transparent_fields AS "transparentFields", a.result_tab FROM vm_alarm_operate_t a WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND ( ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{date}, '%Y-%m' ) ) OR ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( #{date}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH ), '%Y-%m' ))) AND (( a.modifier_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT( a.modifier_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{date}, '%Y-%m-%d' )) OR ( a.modifier_time IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{date}, '%Y-%m-%d' ))) LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

dataTable.alarm_time AS "alarmTime", dataTable.task_id AS "taskId", dataTable.province_code AS "provinceId", dataTable.province_name AS "provinceName", dataTable.city_code AS "cityId", dataTable.comp_confidence_level, '' ) AS "compConfidenceLevel", dataTable.confidence_level_min, dataTable.confidence_level_max, dataTable.front_alarm_vedio_url, dataTable.hori_azimuth_angle, DATE_FORMAT( dataTable.modifier_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{date}, '%Y-%m-%d' )) OR ( dataTable.modifier_date IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT( dataTable.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{date}, '%Y-%m-%d' ))) LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT id AS "flowId", alarm_flow_name AS "alarmFlowName" FROM vm_alarm_flow_config WHERE STATUS = '1'

SELECT t.order_file_id, t.warning_order_id, t.order_flow_id, t.process_order_id, t.link_id, t.resource_id, t.resource_url, t.resource_type, t.file_name, t.file_size, t.file_water_mark AS "fileWaterMark", t.delete_flag, t.create_by, t.create_date, t.modifier_by, t.modifier_date, t.remark, t.process_id, t.process_name FROM vm_order_file_t t WHERE delete_flag = '0'

SELECT a.file_name AS "fileName", a.file_size AS "fileSize", a.process_order_id AS "processOrderId", a.resource_id AS "resourceId", a.resource_url AS "resourceUrl", a.resource_type AS "resourceType", a.file_water_mark AS "fileWaterMark" FROM vm_process_order_photo_t a WHERE a.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT t.warning_order_id, t.file_name, t.file_size, t.resource_id, t.resource_url, t.resource_type, IFNULL(t.file_water_mark,'') AS "fileWaterMark" FROM vm_order_file_t t WHERE t.file_water_mark IS NOT NULL AND t.file_water_mark != '' AND t.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT p.process_order_id, p.file_name, p.file_size, p.resource_id, p.resource_url, p.resource_type, IFNULL(p.file_water_mark,'') AS "fileWaterMark" FROM vm_process_order_photo_t p WHERE p.file_water_mark IS NOT NULL AND p.file_water_mark != '' AND p.delete_flag = '0'
SELECT t.tenant_id AS "tenantId", t.industry_code AS "industryCode", t.warning_source_name AS "warningSourceName" FROM vm_third_party_alarm t WHERE t.delete_flag = 0

SELECT distinct ac.config_id as configId, ac.device_code as deviceCode, ac.channel_code as channelCode, ac.pos_type as posType, ac.tenant_id as tenantId, ac.create_time as createTime, ac.time_interval as timeInterval, ac.time_interval_unit as timeIntervalUnit, ac.algorithm_code as algorithmCode,ac.algorithm_name as algorithmName, ac.creator,ac.modifier, ac.task_id as taskId, IFNULL(vp.preset_name, ac.preset_name) AS presetName, ac.model_config as modelConfig, ac.analysis_period as analysisPeriod, (case when length(IFNULL(tdr.channel_name, '')) = 0 then ch.channel_name else tdr.channel_name end) as channelName, (case when length(IFNULL(tdr.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else tdr.device_name end) as deviceName, ac.industry_code as industryCode, ac.app_ver_code as appVerCode FROM vm_algorithm_config ac LEFT JOIN vm_video_preset vp ON vp.preset_id = ac.preset_id and vp.device_code = ac.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t m ON m.device_code = ac.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ch ON ch.channel_code = ac.channel_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t tdr on tdr.device_code = m.device_code and tdr.channel_code = ch.channel_code and tdr.tenant_id = ac.tenant_id and tdr.industry_code = ac.industry_code where ch.delete_flag = 0 and m.delete_flag = 0
